Blocking expected_output_artifacts guard every transition out of the step;
blocking expected_input_artifacts guard every transition into it (d13).
`overrides` replaces a step or a whole type; only an override may remove a guard
or change a transition (d24). A new workflow is a new mission type (d25).
Inter-step depends_on does not come back (d11).
A mission type's and a step's terms and rejects stay verbatim until #189 (ADR-0050 Status, ADR-0052 d9).
